topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; sanctions statement in POL-01 4.10 (approved 2026-09-04); the marketing contractor is not bound by either
gap: Contractor not bound by conduct or security terms
remediation: Contractor data use and security addendum (POAM-013)

control_description: The majority owner approves High risks and the security budget (P01, 2026-09-04); no regular security reporting to the owner
gap: No recurring owner review of security
remediation: Quarterly security review with the majority owner and General Manager, with minutes

control_description: IT Manager designated Information Security Lead and PCI DSS contact in POL-01 4.2; roles and reporting lines in POL-01 section 3 and the SSP
Part-time IT Manager relies on vendor help desks; no security training plan for the role; cashiers trained on skimmers at hire only
gap: No competence plan for security roles
remediation: Annual security training for the IT Manager; incident response training for managers (POL-03 4.9)

control_description: Security duties assigned in POL-01 to POL-05; signed acknowledgments not yet collected
remediation: Collect POL-05 acknowledgments from all staff and the contractor

control_description: Storefront, identity provider, and cloud logs exist at default retention; not reviewed
remediation: 1-year log retention and weekly review (POAM-010)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-04 but not yet communicated; staff unsure how to report incidents
gap: Internal communication of security duties incomplete
remediation: Training program and incident line briefing (POAM-014; POAM-015)

control_description: Website privacy notice (2019) says member data is never shared, although exports go to a contractor and the pricing vendor; security claim on checkout overstated
evidence: Website capture 2026-07-28; P03 G-069 and G-070
remediation: Rewrite the privacy notice and security statement (POL-01 4.12)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Security objectives set in POL-01 and the SSP (protect card data at the checkout page, loyalty data, and the ability to sell)
Risk assessment with SP 800-30 completed 2026-07-31 (32 risks)
Fraud scenarios in P01 (R-006 refund fraud through the shared POS account, R-007 PIN pad skimming, R-011 account takeover); refund and price override reports not reviewed
gap: No review of refund and override reports
remediation: Weekly refund and price override report review by the Controller

control_description: No process to assess significant changes: the pricing engine went live in March 2026 without a security, privacy, or fairness review
remediation: Change triggers in POL-01 4.3 and 4.13; P10 review before new AI or data uses

control_description: First independent control assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-14 (P07); annual cycle set; no ongoing monitoring between assessments
remediation: Quarterly account and app reviews; payment page monitoring (POAM-009)

control_description: POA&M with owners and dates, approved by the General Manager 2026-09-04; High items reported to the majority owner

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from P01 treatments and the SSP baseline; many are still planned
remediation: Complete planned controls per the POA&M

control_description: Technology controls for identity, backup, and encryption exist; change, monitoring, and script controls missing
remediation: POAM-003, POAM-004, POAM-007

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-04; supporting procedures (access, change, restore) not yet written
remediation: Access, change, and restore procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Single sign-on with MFA for employees; 2 local storefront administrator accounts without MFA; loyalty API keys never rotated
evidence: Identity provider policy; P07 IA-2(1) and IA-5 results
remediation: POAM-001; POAM-006; POAM-017

control_description: New accounts need a manager-approved HR ticket (5 of 5 sampled); the contractor local account was created outside this process
gap: Contractor account outside the registration process
remediation: Contractor moved to single sign-on (POAM-001)

control_description: 4 former employees still active in the storefront; contractor has full administrator rights; no access reviews
remediation: POAM-002; POAM-016; POAM-018

control_description: Provider data centers inherited (storefront, cloud, identity, and productivity providers SOC 2 reports); administrator PCs in the locked store office
Retired administrator PCs wiped by the IT Manager with no record kept
remediation: Disposal log and certified destruction vendor (POL-04 4.9)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Storefront web application firewall and denial-of-service protection (vendor); loyalty API restricted to known addresses; administrator PCs on a flat network with IoT devices
remediation: Office VLAN (POAM-020)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher on all platform endpoints; full loyalty exports emailed monthly as unencrypted attachments
remediation: Stop emailed exports (POAM-019)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: 14 unmanaged scripts on the checkout page; 11 unreviewed storefront apps; signature anti-malware only on administrator PCs
evidence: Browser capture; P07 CM-7 and SI-7 results
gap: No control over scripts that can skim card data
remediation: Script inventory, integrity, and monitoring (POAM-003; POAM-004)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No detection of configuration changes on the checkout page; loyalty API endpoint never scanned
gap: No change detection or vulnerability scanning
remediation: Payment page monitoring (POAM-004); quarterly scan of the loyalty API

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No security monitoring or log review
remediation: POAM-009; POAM-010

control_description: POL-03 requires logging and triage of events; help desk Security category starts 2026-10-31
remediation: Security category in the help desk tool

control_description: E-skimming runbook (P08) approved 2026-09-04; not yet tested
remediation: Tabletop exercise (POAM-005)

control_description: Loyalty database backups in the same account as production; never restore-tested; no continuity plan
remediation: POAM-011; POAM-012

control_description: Theme, tag, and app changes published directly by the contractor with no request, review, or approval
remediation: Change control (POAM-007)

control_description: BIA completed (P05); no continuity plan; cellular failover funded for 2026 Q4
remediation: Continuity and hurricane plan (P01 R-031)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Storefront vendor and POS vendor reports reviewed (Part B); no service provider list or responsibility matrix; contractor and pricing vendor without security terms; processor AOC from 2024
remediation: POAM-013; annual AOC and SOC 2 review
